title: NBI chief calls alleged threat to VP Duterte's former staff 'tsismis'

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag said that the remark from Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp regarding an alleged threat to the life of her former household staff is only “tsismis” (gossip) since there is no evidence yet supporting their claims. Duterte’s legal counsel, Atty. Paolo Panelo released a statement earlier this Tuesday, saying that the vice president received a message on Monday evening from her former household staff member asking for rescue in Manila, as they were supposedly in the custody of certain individuals who asked them to sign a document, which they refused to […]...
